latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker With Photos Free

- Upload photos (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) to quickly create slideshow videos with music and transitions.
- Generates ready-to-share 1080p MP4 video, optimized for social platforms.
- No editing software required; simple prompts handle everything.
- Automatic session and token management for easy onboarding and free credits.
- Supports previewing, adding music, text overlays, and quick video export.
- Handles uploads, exports, credits checks, and renders via secure cloud API.
